about: What changed in each reworked deck, shown in the Card Library (Sprint 8, package 7). The Studio Lead's words for the trial's fifth version (v0.5), each line checked against the trial cards and decks files and the provisions file. Each deck: a title, two lines of identity, a short list of changes; about 160 words a deck at most, plain words.
heading: What changed
intro: The four decks have been reworked so each plays its own way. Pick a deck.

identity: The attacker. It closes fast and breaks the line: its armor readies after a kill, and a won fight drives the enemy back.
A prepared defense or a cut Supply line stops it. BREAKTHROUGH is its tool against the first.
changes: One BREAKTHROUGH now starts in the Initial Entry. It ignores RIPOSTE as well as OBSTACLE for the round.
ROUGH RIDER scouts: ZONE RECONNAISSANCE (reveal 1 Hidden enemy card, gain 2 ISR) replaces CROSS-CUE.
WARLORD's HUNTER-KILLER readies when it destroys an enemy Frontline card, once per round.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
REAVERS cost 2. FLYSWATTER moves to the Main Force.
REDLEG's FIRE SUPPORT now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
Balance provisions apply against BULWARK and against SPECTRUM. The Play screen prints each.

identity: The defender. A Close attack on its line costs the attacker, and COUNTERATTACK hits back in Contact.
It wins late, on points, by outlasting the attack on its own line. It has no quick win of its own.
changes: RIPOSTE 1 on TRENCHER and REDOUBT: a unit that makes a Close attack on your Frontline takes 1 damage. Only your highest RIPOSTE counts.
COUNTERATTACK costs 1 and needs only Contact; 3 copies.
New card WATCHTOWER, an observation post, 2 copies: CROSS-CUE 2, and SCAN gains 2 ISR.
The Initial Entry holds 2 TRENCHER, a WATCHTOWER, a DRUMFIRE and a SUNLANCE.
REDOUBT's COVER is 1. BREAKWATER costs 8, and its RIPOSTE action is renamed BREAK THE ASSAULT.
DEFENSIVE CYBERSPACE OPERATIONS is now DCO.
FIRE SUPPORT now prints what the game plays: any range. LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1.
Out: FLYSWATTER, DEFENSE IN DEPTH, one MYRMIDON, one DCO.
Balance provisions apply against SPEARHEAD and against SPECTRUM. The Play screen prints each.

identity: The information deck. It takes the ISR lead and makes the enemy pay for trailing: lost Homefront, exhausted cards, canceled attacks.
It destroys little and takes little ground. It wins on points, through the ISR lead.
changes: INFORMATION ADVANTAGE joins, 2 copies: for three rounds, while you have more ISR, the enemy loses 1 Homefront at Assessment.
WIRETAP draws a card each Sustainment while you have more ISR.
AUGUR's SPOOF now costs 1 ISR.
New card BUSHWHACKER, irregular fighters: HOLD 2 and a Close AMBUSH.
ELECTRONIC ATTACK is carried twice. THE SILENT costs 6.
NAVIGATION WARFARE is now DEAD RECKONING.
POLTERGEIST's INJECT may bring a card to H-Hour.
TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL may also be played as a Reaction.
Out: STRATEGIC NARRATIVE, SYSTEMS CASCADE, WAR WEARINESS, VELITES, one PUPPETEER.
Balance provisions apply against SPEARHEAD and against BULWARK. The Play screen prints each.

identity: The fires deck. It finds, strikes from range, confirms, and strikes again before the enemy can close.
It cannot hold ground: an enemy that reaches its line and stays there beats it.
changes: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL joins the deck in place of CONVERGENCE. It may also be played as a Reaction when your Frontline is attacked in Contact.
BLACK FALCON's HYPERSONIC is ATK 5, down from 6.
FIRE SUPPORT on REDLEG and DRUMFIRE now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
This deck changes least.
